## Role in the Architecture

The `docs` module is crucial for both developers and operators of the system. It serves as the primary source of information for understanding how to implement, deploy, and manage the software. Overall, the `docs` module encapsulates the project's knowledge base, facilitating a smoother onboarding process and enhancing the maintainability of the project.
